purpose: Public-safe format registry for selected FLARE-FIX-001 evidence; this documents retained receipt shapes and does not validate them, report metrics, or change acceptance gates.

path_policy.source_paths: All paths in this registry are evidence-root-relative.
path_policy.public_selection: A reviewed publication inventory selects files; this registry does not itself select or authorize publication.
path_policy.redaction: Sanitize payload text and exposed names with the reviewed publisher, retain original-to-sanitized hash provenance, and exclude credentials, private topology, private paths, addresses, and operator or container identities.

families.name: phase-plan-and-wrapper-summary

core_fields.plan: arm, audit, epoch_ns and monotonic_ns anchor phase intent and clocks; expected_image, runtime_pins, registry_sha256, and command references bind the managed configuration. epoch_ns and monotonic_ns are integer nanoseconds; request_deadline_epoch is Unix seconds.
core_fields.summary: ok, error, child_returncode, status_samples, audit, epoch_ns, and monotonic_ns record wrapper completion. performance_eligible is always false for these diagnostic runs.

families.unknown_or_null: Absent optional wrapper fields do not alone imply failure or incompleteness. Wrapper outcome is determined by explicit ok, error, child_returncode, and required receipt checks.

families.name: http-attempts-and-failures

core_fields.replay_attempt: case_id and iteration identify an expected replay request; ok, done, message, finish_reasons, usage, output_token_ids, request_ids, body_sha256, and error retain outcome and matching inputs. start_ns and start_epoch_ns are nanoseconds; e2e, visible_ttft, reasoning_ttft, client_generated_ttft, and native_first_token_seconds are seconds when present.
core_fields.decode_attempt: Compact decode rows retain case_id, ok, body_sha256, usage, output_token_ids, decode_tokens_per_second (tokens per second), and speculative_work=null with batch_only_no_request_attribution. They omit replay iteration, start_ns, start_epoch_ns, message, finish_reasons, done, native_first_token_seconds, and request_ids. Raw response files retain the stream, finish, and timestamp inputs validated before compaction.
core_fields.work_and_counters: prompt_tokens and reasoning_tokens carry native accounting when available; speculative_work carries request work except decode, whose batch_speculative_work is in the phase summary. deltas are native before/after counter differences and retain their native units; this registry does not enumerate arbitrary counter names.
core_fields.phase_summary: expected, attempted, completed, missing, error, and performance_eligible preserve denominators and phase outcome. Decode adds batch_speculative_work and speculative_work_scope=whole_drained_batch.

families.unknown_or_null: A missing timing, reasoning count, metric, output, or work field is unknown rather than zero. On a successful replay attempt, omitted error means no error reported; on a successful wrapper summary, error=null has the same meaning when the explicit outcome fields pass. Absent required validity fields still fail the relevant consumer contract. Failed and missing attempts remain in denominators; HTTP success alone does not prove semantic correctness or reuse.

families.name: identity-and-configuration-binding

core_fields.running_proof: Binds the selected managed inventory record to the phase configuration and HTTP served-model alias.
core_fields.status_stream: Ordered managed status observations retain incarnation continuity for a phase.
core_fields.identity_response: The native model-list response supplies the declared served alias used by the normalizer.

families.unknown_or_null: A missing, changed, or unselectable identity binding is an evidence failure. Public copies must scrub operator/container identifiers while retaining sanitized provenance.

families.name: monitoring-and-historical-readiness

core_fields.binding: lane, arm, repetition, generation, traffic_plan_epoch, retrieved_utc, and kind identify a read-only retrospective query at the pre-warmup point.
core_fields.queries: Each named query retains its expression, evaluation_epoch in Unix seconds, and raw Prometheus response. The approved proof consumer checks the declared up/count/minimum/age/freshness contract.

families.unknown_or_null: Empty, ambiguous, failed, or stale query results are retained as evidence limitations; retrospective reads do not claim original live enforcement.

families.name: restoration-and-window-closeout

core_fields.closeout: repetition, arm, targets_requested/completed, warmups_requested/completed, diagnostic_only, performance_eligible, and promoted record bounded-window disposition. incumbent and candidate generation fields bind restoration and fresh incarnations.
core_fields.restoration_readiness: purpose=incumbent-restoration, verification_epoch, generation, and the five raw historical query responses bind readiness to the final retained monitoring observation. verification_epoch is Unix seconds.

families.unknown_or_null: A false or absent default restoration proof remains false even if later supplemental evidence is retained; supplemental receipts must be separately labeled and reviewed.

families.name: gate-proofs-and-proof-index

core_fields.proof: gate, ok, checks, issues, evidence, and scoped fields record a bounded derivation. Native evidence entries retain raw absolute source paths and SHA-256 bindings; those paths can point outside this campaign root, including sibling evidence or product-source files.
core_fields.index: Native proofs maps each named gate to an absolute proof pointer and SHA-256, allowing the normalizer to reject mismatched or absent receipts. Public copies require the reviewed publisher's sanitization and original-to-sanitized provenance mapping; this registry's own evidence-relative representative paths do not describe raw proof-payload path format.

families.unknown_or_null: False gates, issues, and scoped limitations are retained. Functional proof scope is not an independent semantic rescore of every formal request.

families.name: normalized-matrix

core_fields.matrix: diagnostic_only, diagnostic_amendment, runs, source_artifacts, and denominators bind all arms, lanes, attempts, source hashes, receipts, phase summaries, actual order, and normalization_issues.
core_fields.denominators: expected_requests, attempted_requests, failed_attempts, uncertain_target_slots, and attempted_count_is_lower_bound retain coverage without promoting missing evidence to success.

families.unknown_or_null: The frozen producer can normalize incomplete corpora and deliberately retains missing, failed, and uncertain denominators. Selecting a normalized matrix only after campaign closure is final-publication policy. Normalization issues, false receipts, and decode parser limitations remain visible rather than being silently repaired.

families.name: strict-and-descriptive-analysis

core_fields.strict: promoted, recommend_candidate, performance_eligible, comparison_gates_passed, failures, and lane/repetition pair status retain the strict comparison result and full failure denominators.
core_fields.descriptive: diagnostic_only, performance_eligible, recommend_candidate, numerical_gate, p95_method, lanes, source hashes, full-population denominators, match fields, phase sums, and observed_percent_delta describe unqualified observations.

families.unknown_or_null: Descriptive deltas require complete identical measured populations, finite metrics, and no failed measured request; null remains null when that condition is not met. Neither output can override failed numerical, fidelity, independent-oracle, or causal gates.

oracle_and_publication_limits: The sampled-output numerical gate is failed.
No teacher-forced or logit oracle is implemented.
Actual transfer-byte evidence is not a numerical/state-fidelity oracle.
This registry is documentation for a reviewed public inventory, not an acceptance, promotion, or confidentiality certification.
